---
title: "Suppinger gastruloids"
---

Single-cell UMI counts and bulk HTSeq tables come from the murine
gastruloid resource of Suppinger and colleagues (*Cell Stem Cell*,
2023; GEO
[GSE229513](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE229513)
and
[GSE229386](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE229386);
[@suppingerMultimodalCharacterizationMurine2023]).

| Object | GEO | File in `data/raw/` | How it is obtained |
|---|---|---|---|
| Single-cell Seurat object (UMI counts, labels) | GSE229513 | `GSE229513_gastruloidsobject.rds` (about 14 GB) | `dvc pull data/raw/GSE229513_gastruloidsobject.rds.dvc` |
| Bulk HTSeq counts | GSE229386 | `GSE229386_AllHTSeqCountsWithGeneNames.txt.gz` | GEO supplementary file (`data/raw/README.md`) |

: Raw inputs. `data/raw/` is immutable; download commands are recorded in `data/raw/README.md`. {#tbl-raw-inputs}

The scRNA-seq experiment is **one** 10x Chromium 3′ v3 resource from
one specimen series, not a panel of independent biological replicates.
DeCovarT treats it as the one-replicate regime
([2.1, one single-cell replicate](https://bastienchassagnol.github.io/DeCovarT/articles/02-1-single-cell-generative-optimisation.html#sec-one-replicate)).
Zeros are taken as molecule-sampling counts (@nte-drop-zico).
GSE250136 is a later stem-embryo dataset and is not part of this
resource.


**Single-cell (GSE229513).** The first factor is the mESC cell line
(B-S or SBR), the second the time slot. Each line covers six slots,
and only 48 h is profiled in both. At the three times of the bulk
series the cell counts are
(`output/naive_marker_selection/tables/batch_by_time.csv`):

| Time | B-S cells | SBR cells |
|---|---|---|
| 48 h | 5,647 | 5,288 |
| 72 h | 0 | 4,719 |
| 96 h | 4,935 | 0 |

: Single-cell counts per line at the bulk times, before the culture-stress labels are removed (@sec-fs-qc). {#tbl-cells-by-line}

Cell line is therefore confounded with time except at 48 h, and it is
not a covariate in any fit of this book. The two lines are treated as
one developmental trajectory (@fig-bio-space). Gene ranking and
covariance estimation run independently at 48 h, 72 h and 96 h, the
slots with a bulk time point (@sec-fs-glm, @sec-cov-scope). At 48 h
the two lines are pooled; @sec-fs-cell-line measures what pooling
changes.

**Bulk RNA-seq (GSE229386).** The first factor is the Wnt schedule: the
standard pulse at 48 h, or an early pulse at 24 h. The second factor is
the time point, 48 h, 72 h or 96 h, each with three biological
replicates. No single-cell slot carries the early schedule, so the
early-Wnt bulk has no single-cell counterpart at any time. The three
single-cell slots used in this book instead match the three time
points of the standard-Wnt bulk: single-cell 48 h (B-S and SBR pooled),
72 h (SBR) and 96 h (B-S), each against three biological replicates of
the standard-Wnt bulk at that time. The cross-platform filter of
@sec-fs-bulk-consistency is therefore fitted at all three standard-Wnt
time points, never on the early-Wnt arm.

## Seurat processing {#sec-seurat}

Embeddings, QC and clustering follow the Seurat workflow of the
Suppinger resource [@suppingerMultimodalCharacterizationMurine2023],
drawn in @fig-seurat-workflow: Alevin counts, `scater` QC,
`SCTransform` Pearson residuals per batch for integration, CCA, PCA,
UMAP and Louvain clustering. Two products of that workflow are used
here: the cell-type labels (`celltypeannotation`), and the gene list of
the authors' `SCT` counts layer, which serves as the gene allow-list
(@sec-fs-qc). The authors' residuals themselves are not used: the
ranking fits its own negative-binomial GLMs per time slot
(@sec-fs-glm), the legacy panel refitted `SCTransform` v2 per slot
(@sec-fs-sct), and the covariances are estimated from raw counts
(@sec-cov-inputs).

![Seurat workflow used to extract embeddings and downstream analyses on
GSE229513.](images/suppinger_seurat_workflow_single_cell.png){#fig-seurat-workflow}

## Biological interpretation from single-cell compositions {#sec-bio-sc}

@fig-bio-lineage and @fig-bio-space summarise a **putative** reading of
annotated type proportions along gastruloid time. They are not a
reconstruction of embryonic lineages. Two annotated states are treated
as technical artefacts of culture stress (Cd63+ ectoderm-like artefact
and Zscan4+ artefact, `data/dictionaries/suppinger_celltype_crosswalk.csv`).
The working caudal sequence after the Chir/Wnt pulse is pluripotency
$\to$ epiblast $\to$ primitive streak $\to$ caudal mesoderm / NMP
$\to$ pre-somitic mesoderm / somites, with a residual endoderm bias
typical of gastruloids.

![Putative lineage reading of Suppinger annotations (disclaimer: not a
ground-truth DAG).](images/suppinger_biological_itepreation.png){#fig-bio-lineage}

![Spatial / time-slot sketch of type composition, including the B-S and
SBR series.](images/suppinger_biological_itepreation_2.png){#fig-bio-space}

The early-versus-standard Wnt reading of bulk compositions is in
@sec-bio-deconv, after the mean-based comparators of
@sec-deconv-models.
